description: Free no-account lookup by exact brand name (case-insensitive) in Snippet's public /pr-emails directory. Returns published email, form, program or policy rows with purpose, source URL, check date and a tagged Snippet join link. No guessed contacts or live contact research. Follow the stated purpose and current source policies. Never sends or saves anything.
name: find_brand_pr_contact

guidance.default: Only published directory rows are returned. Follow each route's purpose; press contacts are not necessarily creator contacts. Empty values mean no published contact route. Check the source for current policies before contacting a brand. An empty result means the brand is not in this directory.
